notes:
Overview: Verdigris is a mid-market logistics platform building a driver-facing chat assistant + backend embeddings for document search and reranking for pricing decisions. Evaluation target: Private VPC deployment with strict network controls and KMS integration.

Quoted requirements: 'No inference traffic may egress to public internet; all traffic must be over PrivateLink or secure peering and be IP-allowlisted' — CTO. Must support customer-managed keys (rotate keys yearly) and provide audit logs with 1-year retention.

Network specifics requested by infra: PrivateLink endpoint(s) or VPC peering diagram; exact IP ranges for allowlist; firewall rules examples (egress allowed: TCP/443 to Redwood VPC endpoints only); TLS mutual auth support; proxy environment compatibility (HTTP_PROXY) and NAT behaviour for autoscaling nodes. Also asked for guidance on VPC design patterns: single-tenant subnets per environment, NAT Gateway placement, S3 egress endpoints for model artifact fetch, and transit gateway considerations for multi-AZ architecture.

Security review timeline: initial questionnaire submitted 2026-02-20 -> security meeting 2026-02-28 -> action items: provide PrivateLink architecture doc, KMS key policy template, SOC2 audit extract. Legal drafting data residency addendum currently with Verdigris legal.

POC scope: 30-day pilot in prod-like VPC, reserved pool of GPUs (dedicated) for peak routing test, ingest 500k documents to embeddings store, sustained throughput test 5k rps at 95th percentile latency target <150ms for short chat queries. Canary rollout plan requested (canary on 10% traffic -> 50% -> full).

Integration notes: Redwood to demonstrate KMS integration sample with CMKs, provide CloudWatch/Splunk forwarding playbook, and an egress-control checklist. SE to supply exact endpoint IPs and PrivateLink service names for infra to configure firewall allowlist.

Risks & questions: legal needs explicit clause for EU log mirrored retention; infra wants assurance on static endpoint IPs for allowlist or documented alternative (PrivateLink recommended). Cost sensitivity moderate: prefers predictable committed capacity if performance meets SLA.

Next actions: se to deliver PrivateLink diagram + sample firewall rules by 2026-03-07; security to send KMS policy template; schedule pilot kickoff when legal sign-off received.
